scenes.title: Key ideas
scenes.vo: Deploy: due diligence done , before-signing checklist , test amount , journal row (protocol, chain, contracts, amount, entry, thesis, kill rules, approvals). Monitor: daily health factor/pegs/ranges/incidents; weekly P and L versus benchmark, harvest, revoke; monthly register review. Respond: pre-written actions for each trigger (see Module 11.5 for incidents). Review: net return after all costs versus benchmark; simplify anything you can't explain in one sentence.
scenes.cap: Deploy: due diligence done · before-signing checklist · test amount · journal row (protocol, chain, contracts, amount, entry, thesis, kill rules, approvals). Review: net return after all costs vs benchmark; simplify anything you can't explain in one sentence.

scenes.title: Worked example — a journal row
scenes.vo: Position, U.S.D.C. supply, Protocol Y, Arbitrum. Amount / date, $10,000 , 2026-09-01. Thesis, about 5% from real borrow demand. Kill rules, Utilisation > 95% for 48h; oracle or collateral change; any incident. Approvals, U.S.D.C. to Protocol Y pool, limited to $10,000. Weekly, Interest earned, utilisation, governance notes.
